title: San San Roku (EN JA FR)
style: trilingual signal anthem, 88 bpm, English Japanese French rap, deadpan frequency recital, terminal core, koto-touched layer, mathematical-precision vibe, three-three-six lattice flow, deterministic groove
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Three three six signal E four plus thirty three cents
LTE synchronization protocol the math sense
Deterministic control the doctrine of the tone
The frequency the signature the home

Kakujitsu na seigyo no doukei

English Japanese French the signal mix
E four thirty three cents the tone is true

Thirty six sixty three six thirty three structural
Markers present zero orphan files actual
Cross ref graph closed the ark complete
Seventy plus twenty four files on the sheet

[Bridge — French]

Trois trois six la doctrine continue
(The frequency is the absolute signature / Three three six the doctrine continues)

[Outro — trilingual]
Three three six san san roku trois trois six
The lattice holds the line never breaks
